metadata.name: props_vault
metadata.description: Props.trade vault: holds funded-account capital and trades on GMTrade through data-less owner PDAs

accounts.name: trader_usdc
docs: paid by the SOL treasury, if missing.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The trader, or a risk authority.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The trader, or a risk authority for forced closes.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The owner PDA: the claimable account's delegate (it may hold nothing once the account is closed).

accounts.name: claimable
docs: A GMTrade claimable account: token authority = the store, delegate = the owner PDA. Only GMTrade can approve a
delegate for its store's token account.

accounts.name: destination
docs: The account's USDC ATA, or the capital vault once the account is closed.

accounts.name: capital_vault
docs: `init_if_needed`: anyone can create ATA(vault, USDC) first, which must not block initialize.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The trader, or a risk authority for forced closes.

accounts.name: config
docs: Not writable: every order instruction reads it, and settlements must not contend with trading.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Signs the transfer out of its USDC account; loses nothing itself.

accounts.name: owner_usdc
docs: Read only: the account's USDC, which a limit increase's re-assessed fee must fit in.

fields.name: account
docs: The GMTrade claimable token account.

fields.name: to
docs: The account's USDC ATA, or the capital vault for a closed account.

fields.name: size_delta_usd
docs: `u128::MAX` closes the whole position (GMTrade caps it to the position size).

fields.name: max_fee
docs: The most the trader agrees to pay as this order's Props fee (USDC base units): the fee they reviewed, which for a
decrease is its maximum (the rate on its size up to the account's exposure cap), not the fee expected on what it
will close. The order fails with `OrderFeeChanged` if the rate changed so that its fee is higher.

fields.name: cancelled
docs: GMTrade cancelled the order (it never executed): its fee was released. Otherwise it executed and its fee is due.

fields.name: kyc_authority
docs: `Pubkey::default()` until set.

fields.name: capital_vault
docs: ATA(vault, USDC), recorded at initialize.

fields.name: principal_window_start
docs: The current activation window: it opens with the first activation after the previous one ended, lasts a day,
and `principal_in_window` counts what was posted in it.

fields.name: fees_collected
docs: Totals, USDC base units.

fields.name: order_fee_usdc
docs: Props.trade's fee per trader-placed order, set by `set_order_fee`: `order_fee_usdc` (USDC base units) plus
`order_fee_bps` of the order's USD size. 0 = off.

fields.name: subject
docs: The admin, the new admin, the tier or the market config, depending on `change`.

fields.name: min_payout
docs: Minimum trader share of a payout, USDC base units.

fields.name: owner_sol_target
docs: Owner PDA SOL float, lamports: topped up to `owner_sol_target` whenever it drops below `owner_sol_min`.

fields.name: max_daily_principal
docs: Principal `activate_funded` may post per day, USDC base units. Bounds what a compromised risk or KYC key, or a
tampered server database (evaluation results and identities are decided off-chain), can put at risk.

fields.name: lamports
docs: Returned to the SOL treasury.

fields.name: final_equity
docs: Micro-USD.

fields.name: principal
docs: USDC posted from the capital vault (= L).

fields.name: order_seq
docs: GMTrade orders created so far; the next order's nonce (see `next_order_nonce`).

fields.name: order_fees
docs: The fee assessed on `orders[j]` (USDC base units); 0 while `orders[j]` is free or was placed by a risk authority.

fields.name: order_fees_due
docs: Assessed fees of orders that left the book other than through `cancel_order` (executed, or cancelled by the
exchange), not settled yet.

fields.name: order_fees_paid
docs: Order fees charged to the fee vault so far.

fields.name: order_fee_settlements
docs: Settlements so far. `settle_order_fees` names the count it was computed from and advances it, so a settlement
lands once even when `order_fees_due` returns to the value it was computed from.

types.name: IdentityLock
docs: One per person: `init`-only, so an identity can be attached to one wallet.

fields.name: gm_market
docs: GMTrade Market account (pure USDC-USDC, verified at upsert).

fields.name: oi_long_usd
docs: Committed funded open interest (synced size + pending increase orders), GMTrade USD.

fields.name: max_leverage_bps
docs: Leverage limits as size / collateral in bps (25× = 250_000).

fields.name: max_position_usd
docs: Per funded position, micro-USD.

fields.name: max_total_oi_usd
docs: All funded accounts together, per side, micro-USD.

fields.name: order_type
docs: `Market` or `Limit`.

fields.name: collateral
docs: USDC base units moved from the owner ATA into the order.

fields.name: size_delta_usd
docs: GMTrade USD (1 USD = 10^20).

fields.name: trigger_price
docs: GMTrade unit price; required for `Limit`, zero for `Market`.

fields.name: max_fee
docs: The most the trader agrees to pay as this order's Props fee (USDC base units): the fee they reviewed. The order
fails with `OrderFeeChanged` if the rate changed so that its fee is higher.

fields.name: charged
docs: Moved from the account's USDC to the fee vault.

fields.name: waived
docs: Forgiven: nothing moves.

fields.name: order_fees_due
docs: The account's totals after the settlement.

fields.name: fee
docs: The order's Props fee (USDC base units) and the `Config` rate that produced it (0 for a risk authority's order).

fields.name: fee
docs: The order's fee after the update (re-assessed at the current rate) and that rate.

fields.name: balance_at_request
docs: USDC base units.

fields.name: fee
docs: As in `OrderRequested`.

fields.name: order_type
docs: `TakeProfit` or `StopLoss`.

fields.name: max_fee
docs: The most the trader agrees to pay as this order's Props fee (USDC base units): the fee they reviewed, which for a
decrease is its maximum (the rate on its size up to the account's exposure cap), not the fee expected on what it
will close. The order fails with `OrderFeeChanged` if the rate changed so that its fee is higher.

types.name: Slot
docs: One GMTrade position (market, side) of a funded account. Free when `market_token` is default.

fields.name: collateral
docs: Position collateral (USDC base units) and size (GMTrade USD) at the last sync.

fields.name: pending_usd
docs: Σ size of tracked, pending increase orders on this slot.

fields.name: size_usd
docs: Account size S, micro-USD.

fields.name: version
docs: Incremented on every upsert; snapshotted into evaluations.

fields.name: size_usd
docs: Account size S, micro-USD.

fields.name: fee_usdc
docs: Evaluation fee, USDC base units.

types.name: TrackedOrder
docs: A GMTrade order owned by the account's owner PDA. Free when `order` is default.

fields.name: placed_by_risk
docs: Orders placed by a risk authority (forced closes) cannot be cancelled by the trader.

fields.name: identity_hash
docs: Zero until the KYC authority verifies the wallet.

fields.name: max_fee
docs: The most the trader agrees to pay as this order's Props fee (USDC base units): the fee they reviewed, which for a
decrease is its maximum (the rate on its size up to the account's exposure cap), not the fee expected on what it
will close. The order fails with `OrderFeeChanged` if the rate changed so that its fee is higher.
